hero-wars.title: Hero Wars - Epic Fantasy RPG Adventure
hero-wars.description: Embark on an epic journey in Hero Wars, an action-packed RPG where you save the realm of Dominion from chaos. Assemble a team of mighty heroes, upgrade their skills, and engage in thrilling battles. Experience the ultimate fantasy adventure today!

HomeIframe.title: Hero Wars™

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Hero Wars - The Ultimate RPG Experience
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Hero Wars is an action-packed RPG that takes you on an epic journey to save the fantasy realm of Dominion from darkness and chaos. Assemble a team of mighty heroes, upgrade their skills, and engage in thrilling battles against powerful enemies.

HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Upgrade your heroes' skills and equipment.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Engage in strategic battles to conquer enemies.

HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Plan your moves and defeat powerful enemies.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Explore the magical world of Dominion.
